free_tier.stated: "Start 3-day trial - €2.50" on the home page. No free trial is offered; the three-day entry is bought.
free_tier.notes: The trial is a paid product against a Power plan priced at €4.67/month (€14.00 per 3 months).

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap is published. The unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, roughly 750 KB by convention.

retention.stated: "3700+ days of text retention" on the home page; no separate binary retention figure is published there.
retention.notes: The page describes 3700+ days as text completion and says binaries are kept 'as long as possible' with its own algorithm, so the binary depth is not a published number.

egress.terms: "Every plan is unlimited speed and unlimited data"; no traffic price is published.

interface_detail: NNTP on news.hitnews.com ports 119 / 563 / 443, 100 connections. The schema has no nntp token, so the array says unknown.
tooling: any NNTP client; the site supplies server settings only
chaining: A €2.50 three-day burst at unlimited speed is the cheapest way to test a 400 Mbit line, but it is not part of a free month; it is a payment relationship with a 3-day window.

limits.value: unlimited speed; 100 connections on every plan

binding_note: During the three days no vocabulary constraint fails: unlimited data, unlimited speed, 100 connections. At 1 TiB/month the paid Power plan is also unlimited, so the line is the constraint.

identity_cost.detail: The 3-day entry is a €2.50 purchase through /3day.html; no zero-price path is published. The exact instrument at checkout was not read.

reliability_note: The home page rendered an inline error banner ("Sorry! an error occured. Please contact support") next to the pricing content on the read; the price table itself rendered, so the prices are legible but the site is not clean.
confidence_note: The €2.50 / 3-day line and the plan prices are quoted from the vendor page today. Nothing was purchased.

evidence.proved: "Start 3-day trial - €2.50", "3700+ days of text retention, 140,000 newsgroups and 100 connections on every plan", Power €4.67/month, Family €7.00/month, Block from €12.50 per 500 GB

notes: Repeatability: a paid trial is repeatable only by paying again; no vendor sentence is needed and none was found. Abandonment: if a free trial appears on the home page, this record needs a new tier rather than an edit.
